title: My mall world
content: I’ve always had very vivid/lucid dreams for as long as I can remember almost every night and majority of the time I’m in this mall, no matter what it’s alwaysssss an 80’s mall but I’ve never been to an 80’s mall nor am I even close to being born in the 80’s, can someone explain this? It ranges from like a wood escalator with wood accents all over the mall and vines, to just your typical 80’s mall even down to the food court. Explanation?
